allowed_input_artifacts.role: Verify existing individual-model authorization identity only; does not authorize combination.
Source-backed uncertainty meaning, component classification and correlation review evidence only.
Read only per-run reconstructed central values and individual RSS diagnostics; external comparisons and displayed totals are excluded from computational projection.
Official Table 1 capture identity and locator.
Existing external capture identities and fixed source URLs; no numerical target input.
Read the 21 component identities, exact ppm source strings, per-run scope and locators; ignore terminal_comparisons.
Individual input provenance and source locators; no combined target input.
Existing source-review identities and individual reconstruction provenance only.

allowed_inputs: Previously reconstructed individual central values, extracted without external comparisons.
The 21 exact source decimal ppm contributions for each of the three scopes.
Individual variances and RSS uncertainties reconstructed from those components.
Precisely located source statements establishing uncertainty meaning, statistical/non-statistical classification, cross-run correlations and combination/normalization rules.
Only ordinary arithmetic authorized by an unambiguous source rule.

arithmetic_policy.presentation_rounding: none until presentation or terminal comparison
arithmetic_policy.serialization: numbers as decimal strings; stable sorted keys and scope/component order

chronology: This file is the sole substantive change in the first branch commit, before source combination analysis or covariance/combination arithmetic. The audit module shall hard-pin this commit and its bytes; amendments require a new preregistration/version, never an in-place revision.
combination_boundary: No estimator is preregistered by convention. Do not implement generalized least squares, ordinary weighted means, or tuning unless the inspected source uniquely authorizes that exact rule. If a weighting/normalization rule is ambiguous, emit NO-GO and no combined numerical result.

covariance_policy.authorization: Construct only after the source establishes the component mapping and correlations. Do not infer coefficients from a terminal target.
covariance_policy.component_scale: Table 1 direct relative standard contributions in ppm are converted per run using u_k_i = abs(reconstructed_G_i) * ppm_k_i * 1e-6, consistently with the existing individual models.
covariance_policy.inventory: Exactly 21 distinct declared components in each of exactly three scopes; no missing, duplicated, renamed, mis-scoped or extra terms.
covariance_policy.psd_method: Compute principal minors exactly using rational representations of finite Decimal entries; this is a deterministic sign diagnostic, not authoritative floating-point arithmetic.
covariance_policy.singularity: Record exact determinant and invertibility. No inverse, pseudoinverse or regularization is authorized unless required by a source-established estimator; singular cases require an explicit source-backed rule.
validation: diagonal equals per-run component sum of squares in the same Decimal evaluation order
diagonal square root agrees with independently recomputed individual RSS within the explicitly reported Decimal rounding bound
statistical independence and non-statistical shared-item full correlation only if source-authorized
positive semidefiniteness via all seven principal minors of the serialized Decimal matrix

decision_rule.GO: All indispensable source rules and numerical inputs specify a unique target-independent computational path; no scientifically material discretionary choice remains.
decision_rule.NO-GO: At least one indispensable input or rule is missing, ambiguous, target-dependent, or unverified.

evidence_policy: Each source-dependent rule needs a verified precise locator and short quotation. Project mathematical deductions must be labelled as deductions, not quotations or source prescriptions. An ambiguous prescription remains ambiguous even if a conventional formula agrees with the final target.
input_isolation: Read only declared artifacts after verifying bytes and hashes. Extract an explicit allowlisted computational projection. Its schema accepts no terminal targets, totals, weights, coefficients or unknown fields. A terminal comparison is a separate downstream object; changing or deleting it cannot alter any computational result.
nonclaims: No independent experimental or apparatus validation.
No claim that every unknown systematic is covered.
No raw-data or run-level replication, or replication-status promotion.
No physical-independence claim for AAF runs.
A source correlation model is not a theorem about nature.
Terminal agreement does not establish uniqueness of a procedure.
No combined MeasurementModel, physical-bridge schema change, or Lean certification.
question: Does the presently available source-pinned HUST 2018 record specify a complete target-independent combined AAF central estimator and standard uncertainty, including cross-run covariance?

source_intake.bounded_corpus: The fixed article including Methods, Table 1, and linked Supplementary Information/Data already identified in the pinned source records. No open-ended literature search or new experimental data.
source_intake.capture_policy: Verify any recovered binary against its existing hash; record precise locators and short quotes for source rules. Newly accessible official article text may be recorded as a source-review excerpt with its own hash and explicit capture representation; never claim identity to an unavailable PDF. Unverified indispensable source evidence yields SOURCE_UNVERIFIED.
source_intake.review_boundary: Source documents may contain terminal results; those numbers may only enter a separate terminal comparison after a full authorized reconstruction. No comparison is required on NO-GO.

workflow: Focused adversarial tests, relevant HUST suites, full Python suite once at final implementation head, affected freshness guards, frozen-history hash comparison, diff check, clean tree, and exact-head Python plus Lean CI. No milestone tag. Merge commit only after independent audit. Defer unrelated maintenance without assigning IDs.
